ko.title: 주인이 아닌 세입자일 뿐: 법원 판결이 트럼프의 4억 달러 백악관 연회장 계획을 중단

segments.src: A federal appeals court has thrown a major legal obstacle in front of one of the Trump administration's most talked-about construction projects: a sprawling, privately funded ballroom addition to the White House estimated at roughly $400 million.
segments.tr: 연방 항소법원이 트럼프 행정부의 가장 주목받는 건설 프로젝트 중 하나 앞에 큰 법적 장애물을 던졌다. 백악관에 대한 광대한 민간 자금 지원 연회장 추가로, 대략 4억 달러로 추정된다.

segments.src: In a split 2-1 decision, the panel ordered a halt to further construction until Congress signs off on the plan, setting up what could become a landmark Supreme Court showdown over how much authority a sitting president actually has to remake a building that belongs, in the judges' words, to the nation rather than to any one occupant.
segments.tr: 2-1로 나뉜 판결에서, 판사단은 의회가 계획에 승인할 때까지 추가 건설을 중단하도록 명령했으며, 판사들의 말에 따르면 개인 점유자가 아닌 국가에 속한 건물을 다시 만들 수 있는 권한이 현직 대통령에게 실제로 얼마나 있는지에 대한 역사적 대법원 대결이 될 수 있는 상황을 설정했다.

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## 법원이 결정한 것

segments.src: The majority opinion centered on a deceptively simple idea: the president lives in the White House, but does not own it.
segments.tr: 다수 의견은 기만적으로 단순한 생각에 중심을 두었다: 대통령은 백악관에 살지만, 소유하지 않는다.

segments.src: The building is federal property held in trust for the public, and major structural changes historically have required some form of congressional review or funding approval.
segments.tr: 건물은 국민을 위해 신탁으로 보유한 연방 자산이며, 역사적으로 주요 구조 변경은 어떤 형태의 의회 검토 또는 자금 승인이 필요했다.

segments.src: The panel found that the ballroom project — one of the largest physical alterations to the executive mansion in decades — crossed a threshold that could not be authorized by executive discretion or private donations alone.
segments.tr: 판사단은 연회장 프로젝트 — 수십 년 만의 행정 저택에 대한 가장 큰 물리적 변경 중 하나 — 이 행정부의 재량이나 민간 기부만으로는 승인될 수 없는 임계값을 넘었다는 것을 발견했다.

segments.src: The dissenting judge argued the opposite, warning that the ruling could open the door to years of litigation any time a future president wants to renovate, redecorate, or expand facilities at the White House, and that courts should be cautious about inserting themselves into decisions traditionally left to the executive branch.
segments.tr: 반대 의견의 판사는 그 반대를 주장하며, 판결이 미래의 대통령이 백악관의 시설을 개조, 재장식 또는 확장하고 싶을 때마다 수년간의 소송의 문을 열 수 있으며, 법원은 전통적으로 행정부에 맡겨진 결정에 자신을 개입시키는 것에 대해 조심해야 한다고 경고했다.

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight
segments.tr: ## 분쟁의 중심에 있는 프로젝트

segments.src: The ballroom itself has been pitched by supporters as a long-overdue upgrade, giving the White House a modern, large-capacity event space for state dinners and diplomatic functions instead of relying on tents erected on the South Lawn.
segments.tr: 연회장 자체는 지지자들에 의해 오래 기다린 업그레이드로 제시되었으며, 남쪽 잔디에 세워진 텐트에 의존하는 대신 백악관에 국무 만찬과 외교 기능을 위한 현대적이고 대용량의 이벤트 공간을 제공한다.

segments.src: Backers point out that the project is being funded largely through private donations rather than taxpayer dollars, arguing that this should insulate it from the kind of congressional budget scrutiny that applies to publicly financed construction.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 프로젝트가 납세자 달러보다는 민간 기부를 통해 대부분 자금을 지원받고 있으며, 이것이 공개 자금 건설에 적용되는 의회 예산 정밀조사로부터 보호해야 한다고 주장한다.

segments.src: Critics counter that the source of funding is beside the point.
segments.tr: 비평가들은 자금의 출처가 요점이 아니라고 반박한다.

segments.src: Because the White House is a historic landmark and a symbol of the presidency itself, they argue any project of this scale — reshaping sightlines, altering historic structures, and potentially affecting the building's protected architectural character — needs sign-off from bodies like the National Capital Planning Commission and, ultimately, lawmakers who oversee federal property.
segments.tr: 백악관은 역사적 랜드마크이자 대통령직의 상징이기 때문에, 그들은 이 규모의 모든 프로젝트 — 시야를 재형성하고, 역사적 구조를 변경하고, 잠재적으로 건물의 보호된 건축 특성에 영향을 미치는 — 국립 수도 계획 위원회와 같은 기구의 승인과 궁극적으로 연방 자산을 감시하는 입법자의 승인이 필요하다고 주장한다.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Ballroom
segments.tr: ## 이 사건이 연회장을 넘어 중요한 이유

segments.src: Legal analysts following the case say the real stakes go well past a single construction project.
segments.tr: 사건을 추적하는 법률 분석가들은 실제 이해관계가 단일 건설 프로젝트를 훨씬 능가한다고 말한다.

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?
segments.tr: 문제가 되는 것은 더 광범위한 질문이다: 백악관에 대한 대통령의 재량이 어디서 끝나고, 의회 및 공개 감시가 어디서 시작되는가?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: 과거 대통령들은 거주지에 변화를 주었다 — 추가된 발코니에서 개조된 사무실까지 — 하지만 거의 또는 전혀 이 규모나 가격표에 접근하지 않았으며, 이는 사건이 헌법 학자뿐만 아니라 역사적 보존 옹호자들의 주의를 끌었던 이유의 일부이다.

segments.src: A ruling that stands would reinforce the idea that the White House functions similarly to other protected federal landmarks, where alterations are subject to institutional checks regardless of who currently occupies the building.
segments.tr: 확정된 판결은 백악관이 다른 보호된 연방 랜드마크와 유사하게 기능한다는 생각을 강화할 것이며, 현재 건물을 점유하는 사람과 상관없이 변경이 제도적 검사의 대상이 된다.

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: 반면에, 역전은 미래의 대통령들에게 민간 자금을 사용하여 대규모 변경을 자금 조달하고 실행할 수 있는 상당히 더 많은 자유도를 제공할 것이며, 일반적인 의회 세입 절차를 우회한다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 다음에 어떻게 되는가

segments.src: The administration is expected to appeal, and most observers believe the dispute is likely headed toward the Supreme Court given the constitutional questions involved about separation of powers and control over the "people's house."
segments.tr: 행정부는 항소할 것으로 예상되며, 대부분의 관찰자들은 권력 분리와 "국민의 집"에 대한 통제에 관련된 헌법 질문을 고려할 때 분쟁이 대법원으로 향할 가능성이 높다고 믿는다.

segments.src: Construction crews have reportedly paused major work on the site while the legal process plays out, though preliminary planning and design work may continue.
segments.tr: 건설 팀은 법적 절차가 진행되는 동안 현장에서 주요 작업을 일시 중지했다고 보도되었지만, 예비 계획 및 설계 작업은 계속될 수 있다.

segments.src: For now, the ruling stands as a reminder that even the president's own residence comes with limits — a reminder rooted less in politics than in a basic legal principle: occupancy is not the same as ownership.
segments.tr: 현재로서는, 판결은 대통령의 거주지도 제한을 받는다는 점을 상기시켜주며 — 이는 정치보다는 기본적인 법적 원칙에 기반한 상기시킴이다: 점유는 소유권과 같지 않다.

zh.title: 不是所有者,只是租户:法院裁决阻止特朗普的4亿美元白宫宴会厅计划

segments.src: A federal appeals court has thrown a major legal obstacle in front of one of the Trump administration's most talked-about construction projects: a sprawling, privately funded ballroom addition to the White House estimated at roughly $400 million.
segments.tr: 一个联邦上诉法院对特朗普政府最受关注的建筑项目之一设置了重大法律障碍:一个庞大的、私人资助的白宫宴会厅扩建项目,估计花费约4亿美元。

segments.src: In a split 2-1 decision, the panel ordered a halt to further construction until Congress signs off on the plan, setting up what could become a landmark Supreme Court showdown over how much authority a sitting president actually has to remake a building that belongs, in the judges' words, to the nation rather than to any one occupant.
segments.tr: 在一项2-1的分裂判决中,该法庭下令暂停进一步施工,直到国会批准该计划。这可能导致一场里程碑式的最高法院对峙,关于在任总统对这座属于国家(而非任何一个人)的建筑物究竟有多大权力进行改造。

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## 法院的决定

segments.src: The majority opinion centered on a deceptively simple idea: the president lives in the White House, but does not own it.
segments.tr: 多数意见围绕一个看似简单的观点展开:总统住在白宫,但并不拥有它。

segments.src: The building is federal property held in trust for the public, and major structural changes historically have required some form of congressional review or funding approval.
segments.tr: 这座建筑是以信托形式为公众持有的联邦财产,历史上重大结构改变需要某种形式的国会审查或资金批准。

segments.src: The panel found that the ballroom project — one of the largest physical alterations to the executive mansion in decades — crossed a threshold that could not be authorized by executive discretion or private donations alone.
segments.tr: 该法庭认定,这个宴会厅项目——是几十年来对白宫最大的实体改造之一——超越了仅凭行政权力或私人捐赠无法授权的阈值。

segments.src: The dissenting judge argued the opposite, warning that the ruling could open the door to years of litigation any time a future president wants to renovate, redecorate, or expand facilities at the White House, and that courts should be cautious about inserting themselves into decisions traditionally left to the executive branch.
segments.tr: 持不同意见的法官持相反观点,警告该裁决可能会开启一扇门,让未来总统任何想翻新、重新装饰或扩展白宫设施时都面临多年诉讼,法院应谨慎介入传统上由行政部门做出的决定。

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight
segments.tr: ## 斗争中心的项目

segments.src: The ballroom itself has been pitched by supporters as a long-overdue upgrade, giving the White House a modern, large-capacity event space for state dinners and diplomatic functions instead of relying on tents erected on the South Lawn.
segments.tr: 宴会厅本身被支持者吹捧为一项迫切需要的升级,为白宫提供一个现代、大容量的活动空间来举办国宴和外交活动,而无需依赖南草坪上搭建的帐篷。

segments.src: Backers point out that the project is being funded largely through private donations rather than taxpayer dollars, arguing that this should insulate it from the kind of congressional budget scrutiny that applies to publicly financed construction.
segments.tr: 支持者指出,该项目主要通过私人捐赠而非纳税人资金进行融资,辩称这应该使其免受适用于公共资助建筑的国会预算审查。

segments.src: Critics counter that the source of funding is beside the point.
segments.tr: 批评者反驳说资金来源无关紧要。

segments.src: Because the White House is a historic landmark and a symbol of the presidency itself, they argue any project of this scale — reshaping sightlines, altering historic structures, and potentially affecting the building's protected architectural character — needs sign-off from bodies like the National Capital Planning Commission and, ultimately, lawmakers who oversee federal property.
segments.tr: 因为白宫是一个历史地标和总统制本身的象征,他们辩称任何这样规模的项目——重塑景观线、改变历史结构,以及可能影响建筑受保护的建筑特征——需要得到国家首都规划委员会等机构以及最终监督联邦财产的立法者的批准。

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Ballroom
segments.tr: ## 为什么这个案件的重要性超越了宴会厅

segments.src: Legal analysts following the case say the real stakes go well past a single construction project.
segments.tr: 跟踪此案的法律分析师表示,真正的风险远远超出单个建筑项目的范围。

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?
segments.tr: 问题所在是一个更广泛的问题:总统对白宫的自由裁量权在哪里结束,国会和公众监督在哪里开始?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: 过去的总统对官邸进行了改变——从增加阳台到翻新办公室——但很少有人(如果有的话)接近这样的规模或价格,这正是为什么该案件引起了宪法学者和历史保护倡导者的关注。

segments.src: A ruling that stands would reinforce the idea that the White House functions similarly to other protected federal landmarks, where alterations are subject to institutional checks regardless of who currently occupies the building.
segments.tr: 一项成立的裁决将强化这样一个观点:白宫的运作方式类似于其他受保护的联邦地标,其中的改变受制度制约,无论谁当前占据该建筑。

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: 另一方面,一项撤销将给予未来总统相当大的空间来使用私人资金融资并执行大规模改变,绕过通常的国会拨款程序。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: The administration is expected to appeal, and most observers believe the dispute is likely headed toward the Supreme Court given the constitutional questions involved about separation of powers and control over the "people's house."
segments.tr: 预计行政部门将提出上诉,大多数观察人士认为鉴于涉及权力分离和对"人民之家"的控制的宪法问题,这一争议很可能走向最高法院。

segments.src: Construction crews have reportedly paused major work on the site while the legal process plays out, though preliminary planning and design work may continue.
segments.tr: 据报道,在法律程序进行期间,施工队已暂停了现场的主要工作,尽管初步规划和设计工作可能会继续。

segments.src: For now, the ruling stands as a reminder that even the president's own residence comes with limits — a reminder rooted less in politics than in a basic legal principle: occupancy is not the same as ownership.
segments.tr: 目前,该裁决提醒我们,即使总统自己的住所也有限制——这一提醒不是源于政治,而是源于一项基本法律原则:居住权不等于所有权。

segments.tr: असहमत न्यायाधीश ने विपरीत तर्क दिया, चेतावनी दी कि यह फैसला किसी भी समय मुकदमेबाजी के वर्षों का दरवाजा खोल सकता है जब कोई भविष्य के राष्ट्रपति व्हाइट हाउस में सुविधाओं को नवीनीकृत, सजाना या विस्तारित करना चाहते हैं, और कि अदालतों को उन निर्णयों में स्वयं को शामिल करने के बारे में सावधान रहना चाहिए जो परंपरागत रूप से कार्यकारी शाखा के लिए छोड़े गए हैं।

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight
segments.tr: ## लड़ाई के केंद्र में परियोजना

segments.src: The ballroom itself has been pitched by supporters as a long-overdue upgrade, giving the White House a modern, large-capacity event space for state dinners and diplomatic functions instead of relying on tents erected on the South Lawn.
segments.tr: बॉलरूम को समर्थकों द्वारा एक लंबे समय से अपेक्षित अपग्रेड के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया गया है, जो व्हाइट हाउस को राज्य रात्रिभोज और राजनयिक कार्यों के लिए एक आधुनिक, बड़ी क्षमता वाली इवेंट स्पेस देता है, दक्षिण लॉन पर लगाए गए तंबुओं पर निर्भरता के बजाय।

segments.src: Backers point out that the project is being funded largely through private donations rather than taxpayer dollars, arguing that this should insulate it from the kind of congressional budget scrutiny that applies to publicly financed construction.
segments.tr: समर्थक इंगित करते हैं कि परियोजना को करदाता डॉलर के बजाय काफी हद तक निजी दान के माध्यम से वित्त पोषित किया जा रहा है, तर्क देते हुए कि यह इसे उस प्रकार की कांग्रेसी बजट जांच से बचाता है जो सार्वजनिक रूप से वित्त पोषित निर्माण पर लागू होता है।

segments.src: Critics counter that the source of funding is beside the point.
segments.tr: आलोचकों का तर्क है कि वित्त पोषण का स्रोत बिंदु के बगल में है।

segments.src: Because the White House is a historic landmark and a symbol of the presidency itself, they argue any project of this scale — reshaping sightlines, altering historic structures, and potentially affecting the building's protected architectural character — needs sign-off from bodies like the National Capital Planning Commission and, ultimately, lawmakers who oversee federal property.
segments.tr: क्योंकि व्हाइट हाउस एक ऐतिहासिक मील का पत्थर और राष्ट्रपति पद का प्रतीक है, वे तर्क देते हैं कि इस पैमाने की कोई भी परियोजना — दृश्य पुनर्गठन, ऐतिहासिक संरचनाओं में परिवर्तन, और संभावित रूप से इमारत के संरक्षित वास्तुकला चरित्र को प्रभावित करना — राष्ट्रीय राजधानी योजना आयोग जैसी संस्थाओं से मंजूरी की आवश्यकता है और, अंततः, संघीय संपत्ति की देखरेख करने वाले विधायक।

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Ballroom
segments.tr: ## यह मामला बॉलरूम से परे क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है

segments.src: Legal analysts following the case say the real stakes go well past a single construction project.
segments.tr: मामले का पालन करने वाले कानूनी विश्लेषक कहते हैं कि वास्तविक दांव एक एकल निर्माण परियोजना से बहुत आगे जाते हैं।

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?
segments.tr: मुद्दा एक व्यापक प्रश्न है: व्हाइट हाउस पर राष्ट्रपति विवेक कहां समाप्त होता है, और कांग्रेसी और जनता की देखरेख कहां शुरू होती है?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: पिछले राष्ट्रपतियों ने निवास में परिवर्तन किए हैं — जोड़े गए बालकनियों से लेकर नवीनीकृत कार्यालयों तक — लेकिन कुछ, यदि कोई हो, ने इस पैमाने या मूल्य टैग के करीब पहुंचे हैं, जो आंशिक रूप से यह है कि इस मामले ने संवैधानिक विद्वानों और ऐतिहासिक संरक्षण वकीलों का ध्यान आकर्षित किया है।

segments.src: A ruling that stands would reinforce the idea that the White House functions similarly to other protected federal landmarks, where alterations are subject to institutional checks regardless of who currently occupies the building.
segments.tr: एक फैसला जो खड़ा होता है, यह विचार प्रबलित करेगा कि व्हाइट हाउस अन्य संरक्षित संघीय मील के पत्थर के समान कार्य करता है, जहां परिवर्तन संस्थागत जांच के अधीन हैं, चाहे कोई भी इमारत में वर्तमान में रहता हो।

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: दूसरी ओर, एक उलटफेर भविष्य के राष्ट्रपतियों को निजी पैसे का उपयोग करके बड़े पैमाने पर परिवर्तनों को वित्त पोषित और क्रियान्वित करने के लिए काफी अधिक अक्षांश देगा, सामान्य कांग्रेसी उपयोग प्रक्रिया को दरकिनार करते हुए।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## इसके बाद क्या होगा

segments.src: The administration is expected to appeal, and most observers believe the dispute is likely headed toward the Supreme Court given the constitutional questions involved about separation of powers and control over the "people's house."
segments.tr: प्रशासन से अपील करने की अपेक्षा की जाती है, और अधिकांश पर्यवेक्षकों को विश्वास है कि विवाद सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की ओर जाने की संभावना है क्योंकि शक्तियों के पृथक्करण और "जनता के घर" पर नियंत्रण के बारे में शामिल संवैधानिक प्रश्न।

segments.src: Construction crews have reportedly paused major work on the site while the legal process plays out, though preliminary planning and design work may continue.
segments.tr: निर्माण दलों ने कानूनी प्रक्रिया चलते समय साइट पर प्रमुख कार्य को रोका है, हालांकि प्रारंभिक योजना और डिजाइन कार्य जारी रह सकते हैं।

segments.src: For now, the ruling stands as a reminder that even the president's own residence comes with limits — a reminder rooted less in politics than in a basic legal principle: occupancy is not the same as ownership.
segments.tr: अब के लिए, यह फैसला एक अनुस्मारक के रूप में खड़ा है कि यहां तक ​​कि राष्ट्रपति का अपना निवास भी सीमाओं के साथ आता है — एक अनुस्मारक जो राजनीति में कम निहित है बल्कि एक बुनियादी कानूनी सिद्धांत में: कब्जा स्वामित्व के समान नहीं है।

es.title: No es el Propietario, Solo un Inquilino: Fallo Judicial Detiene el Plan de Salón de Baile de la Casa Blanca de $400 Millones de Trump

segments.src: A federal appeals court has thrown a major legal obstacle in front of one of the Trump administration's most talked-about construction projects: a sprawling, privately funded ballroom addition to the White House estimated at roughly $400 million.
segments.tr: Una corte federal de apelaciones ha interpuesto un importante obstáculo legal frente a uno de los proyectos de construcción más comentados de la administración Trump: una amplia adición de salón de baile financiada con fondos privados en la Casa Blanca estimada en aproximadamente $400 millones.

segments.src: In a split 2-1 decision, the panel ordered a halt to further construction until Congress signs off on the plan, setting up what could become a landmark Supreme Court showdown over how much authority a sitting president actually has to remake a building that belongs, in the judges' words, to the nation rather than to any one occupant.
segments.tr: En una decisión dividida de 2-1, el panel ordenó detener la construcción adicional hasta que el Congreso apruebe el plan, configurando lo que podría convertirse en un enfrentamiento histórico en la Corte Suprema sobre cuánta autoridad tiene realmente un presidente en funciones para remodelar un edificio que pertenece, según las palabras de los jueces, a la nación en lugar de a cualquier ocupante.

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## Lo que la Corte Decidió

segments.src: The majority opinion centered on a deceptively simple idea: the president lives in the White House, but does not own it.
segments.tr: La opinión mayoritaria se centró en una idea engañosamente simple: el presidente vive en la Casa Blanca, pero no la posee.

segments.src: The building is federal property held in trust for the public, and major structural changes historically have required some form of congressional review or funding approval.
segments.tr: El edificio es propiedad federal en fideicomiso para el público, y históricamente los cambios estructurales importantes han requerido alguna forma de revisión del Congreso o aprobación de financiamiento.

segments.src: The panel found that the ballroom project — one of the largest physical alterations to the executive mansion in decades — crossed a threshold that could not be authorized by executive discretion or private donations alone.
segments.tr: El panel encontró que el proyecto de salón de baile — una de las alteraciones físicas más grandes de la mansión ejecutiva en décadas — cruzó un umbral que no podría ser autorizado por discreción ejecutiva o donaciones privadas solas.

segments.src: The dissenting judge argued the opposite, warning that the ruling could open the door to years of litigation any time a future president wants to renovate, redecorate, or expand facilities at the White House, and that courts should be cautious about inserting themselves into decisions traditionally left to the executive branch.
segments.tr: El juez disidente argumentó lo opuesto, advirtiendo que el fallo podría abrir la puerta a años de litigio cada vez que un futuro presidente quiera renovar, redecorar o expandir las instalaciones de la Casa Blanca, y que los tribunales deberían ser cautelosos sobre insertarse en decisiones tradicionalmente dejadas a la rama ejecutiva.

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight
segments.tr: ## El Proyecto en el Centro del Conflicto

segments.tr: El salón de baile en sí ha sido presentado por los partidarios como una actualización muy esperada, dando a la Casa Blanca un espacio de eventos moderno y de gran capacidad para cenas de Estado y funciones diplomáticas en lugar de depender de tiendas de campaña erigidas en el South Lawn.

segments.src: Backers point out that the project is being funded largely through private donations rather than taxpayer dollars, arguing that this should insulate it from the kind of congressional budget scrutiny that applies to publicly financed construction.
segments.tr: Los partidarios señalan que el proyecto se financia en gran medida a través de donaciones privadas en lugar de dólares de los contribuyentes, argumentando que esto debería protegerlo del tipo de escrutinio presupuestario del Congreso que se aplica a la construcción financiada públicamente.

segments.src: Critics counter that the source of funding is beside the point.
segments.tr: Los críticos argumentan que la fuente de financiamiento es irrelevante.

segments.tr: Debido a que la Casa Blanca es un monumento histórico y un símbolo de la presidencia en sí, argumentan que cualquier proyecto de esta escala — remodelar líneas visuales, alterar estructuras históricas, y potencialmente afectar el carácter arquitectónico protegido del edificio — necesita la aprobación de organismos como la Comisión Nacional de Planificación de la Capital y, en última instancia, legisladores que supervisen la propiedad federal.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Ballroom
segments.tr: ## Por Qué Este Caso Importa Más Allá del Salón de Baile

segments.tr: Los analistas legales que siguen el caso dicen que los intereses reales van mucho más allá de un único proyecto de construcción.

segments.tr: En cuestión hay una pregunta más amplia: ¿dónde termina la discreción presidencial sobre la Casa Blanca, y dónde comienza la supervisión del Congreso y del público?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: Los presidentes anteriores han hecho cambios en la residencia — desde balcones agregados hasta oficinas renovadas — pero pocos, si acaso, se han acercado a esta escala o precio, que es parte de por qué el caso ha atraído la atención de estudiosos constitucionales así como defensores de la preservación histórica.

segments.tr: لأن البيت الأبيض هو معلم تاريخي ورمز للرئاسة نفسها، يجادلون بأن أي مشروع بهذا الحجم — إعادة تشكيل خطوط الرؤية، وتعديل الهياكل التاريخية، والتأثير المحتمل على الطابع المعماري المحمي للمبنى — يحتاج إلى موافقة من هيئات مثل هيئة تخطيط العاصمة الوطنية، وفي النهاية، المشرعين الذين يشرفون على الملكية الفيدرالية.

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: لقد أجرى الرؤساء السابقون تغييرات على الإقامة — من شرفات مضافة إلى مكاتب مجددة — لكن القليل منهم، إن وجد، اقتربوا من هذا الحجم أو سعر العلامة السعرية، وهذا جزء من السبب الذي جعل القضية تجذب انتباه العلماء الدستوريين وكذلك دعاة الحفاظ على التاريخ.

segments.tr: ستعزز محكمة تصمد الفكرة القائلة بأن البيت الأبيض يعمل بشكل مشابه لمعالم فيدرالية محمية أخرى، حيث تخضع التعديلات لفحوصات مؤسسية بغض النظر عن من يشغل المبنى حالياً.

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: من ناحية أخرى، ستمنح الانعكاسة الرؤساء المستقبليين حرية أكبر بكثير لتمويل وتنفيذ تغييرات واسعة النطاق باستخدام أموال خاصة، مما يتجاوز عملية المخصصات البرلمانية المعتادة.

fr.title: Pas propriétaire, juste locataire : Une décision de justice arrête le projet de salle de bal de 400 millions de dollars de la Maison-Blanche de Trump

segments.src: A federal appeals court has thrown a major legal obstacle in front of one of the Trump administration's most talked-about construction projects: a sprawling, privately funded ballroom addition to the White House estimated at roughly $400 million.
segments.tr: Une cour d'appel fédérale a dressé un obstacle juridique majeur devant l'un des projets de construction les plus médiatisés de l'administration Trump : un vaste ajout de salle de bal financé par le secteur privé à la Maison-Blanche, estimé à environ 400 millions de dollars.

segments.src: In a split 2-1 decision, the panel ordered a halt to further construction until Congress signs off on the plan, setting up what could become a landmark Supreme Court showdown over how much authority a sitting president actually has to remake a building that belongs, in the judges' words, to the nation rather than to any one occupant.
segments.tr: Dans une décision divisée 2-1, le panel a ordonné l'arrêt des travaux de construction jusqu'à ce que le Congrès approuve le plan, mettant en place ce qui pourrait devenir un affrontement historique à la Cour suprême sur l'autorité dont dispose réellement un président en exercice pour transformer un bâtiment qui appartient, selon les termes des juges, à la nation plutôt qu'à un occupant quelconque.

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## Ce que la Cour a décidé

segments.src: The majority opinion centered on a deceptively simple idea: the president lives in the White House, but does not own it.
segments.tr: L'opinion majoritaire s'est concentrée sur une idée trompeusement simple : le président vit à la Maison-Blanche, mais ne la possède pas.

segments.src: The building is federal property held in trust for the public, and major structural changes historically have required some form of congressional review or funding approval.
segments.tr: Le bâtiment est une propriété fédérale détenue en fiducie pour le public, et les changements structurels majeurs ont historiquement nécessité une forme d'examen du Congrès ou d'approbation de financement.

segments.src: The panel found that the ballroom project — one of the largest physical alterations to the executive mansion in decades — crossed a threshold that could not be authorized by executive discretion or private donations alone.
segments.tr: Le panel a constaté que le projet de salle de bal — l'une des plus grandes modifications physiques du palais présidentiel en décennies — franchissait un seuil qui ne pouvait pas être autorisé par la seule discrétion exécutive ou des donations privées.

segments.src: The dissenting judge argued the opposite, warning that the ruling could open the door to years of litigation any time a future president wants to renovate, redecorate, or expand facilities at the White House, and that courts should be cautious about inserting themselves into decisions traditionally left to the executive branch.
segments.tr: Le juge dissident a argumenté le contraire, avertissant que la décision pourrait ouvrir la porte à des années de litiges chaque fois qu'un futur président voudrait rénover, redécorer ou agrandir les installations de la Maison-Blanche, et que les tribunaux devraient être prudents en s'immisçant dans les décisions traditionnellement laissées à la branche exécutive.

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight
segments.tr: ## Le projet au cœur du conflit

segments.src: The ballroom itself has been pitched by supporters as a long-overdue upgrade, giving the White House a modern, large-capacity event space for state dinners and diplomatic functions instead of relying on tents erected on the South Lawn.
segments.tr: La salle de bal elle-même a été présentée par les partisans comme une mise à niveau très attendue, donnant à la Maison-Blanche un espace événementiel moderne et de grande capacité pour les dîners d'État et les fonctions diplomatiques au lieu de s'appuyer sur des tentes dressées sur la Pelouse sud.

segments.src: Backers point out that the project is being funded largely through private donations rather than taxpayer dollars, arguing that this should insulate it from the kind of congressional budget scrutiny that applies to publicly financed construction.
segments.tr: Les partisans soulignent que le projet est financé largement par des donations privées plutôt que par les dollars des contribuables, arguant que cela devrait le protéger du type d'examen budgétaire du Congrès qui s'applique aux constructions financées publiquement.

segments.src: Critics counter that the source of funding is beside the point.
segments.tr: Les critiques rétorquent que la source de financement n'est pas l'essentiel.

segments.src: Because the White House is a historic landmark and a symbol of the presidency itself, they argue any project of this scale — reshaping sightlines, altering historic structures, and potentially affecting the building's protected architectural character — needs sign-off from bodies like the National Capital Planning Commission and, ultimately, lawmakers who oversee federal property.
segments.tr: Parce que la Maison-Blanche est un monument historique et un symbole de la présidence elle-même, ils arguent que tout projet de cette envergure — redéfinir les perspectives visuelles, modifier les structures historiques et affecter potentiellement le caractère architectural protégé du bâtiment — a besoin de l'approbation d'organismes comme la Commission de planification de la capitale nationale et, en fin de compte, des législateurs qui supervisent les propriétés fédérales.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Ballroom
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cette affaire a de l'importance au-delà de la salle de bal

segments.src: Legal analysts following the case say the real stakes go well past a single construction project.
segments.tr: Les analystes juridiques suivant l'affaire disent que les enjeux réels vont bien au-delà d'un seul projet de construction.

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?
segments.tr: La question en jeu est plus large : où s'arrête la discrétion présidentielle sur la Maison-Blanche, et où commence la surveillance du Congrès et du public ?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: Les présidents précédents ont apporté des changements à la résidence — des balcons ajoutés aux bureaux rénovés — mais peu, voire aucun, n'ont approché cette envergure ou ce prix, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi l'affaire a attiré l'attention des constitutionnalistes ainsi que des partisans de la préservation historique.

segments.src: A ruling that stands would reinforce the idea that the White House functions similarly to other protected federal landmarks, where alterations are subject to institutional checks regardless of who currently occupies the building.
segments.tr: Une décision qui tient bon renforcerait l'idée que la Maison-Blanche fonctionne de manière similaire à d'autres monuments fédéraux protégés, où les modifications sont soumises à des contrôles institutionnels indépendamment de qui occupe actuellement le bâtiment.

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: Un renversement, en revanche, donnerait aux futurs présidents une latitude considérablement plus importante pour financer et exécuter des changements à grande échelle en utilisant de l'argent privé, contournant le processus habituel d'appropriation du Congrès.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il ensuite

segments.src: The administration is expected to appeal, and most observers believe the dispute is likely headed toward the Supreme Court given the constitutional questions involved about separation of powers and control over the "people's house."
segments.tr: On s'attend à ce que l'administration fasse appel, et la plupart des observateurs croient que le différend se dirige probablement vers la Cour suprême compte tenu des questions constitutionnelles impliquées concernant la séparation des pouvoirs et le contrôle de la "maison du peuple".

segments.src: Construction crews have reportedly paused major work on the site while the legal process plays out, though preliminary planning and design work may continue.
segments.tr: Les équipes de construction auraient apparemment suspendu les travaux majeurs sur le site pendant que le processus juridique se déroule, bien que les travaux préliminaires de planification et de conception puissent continuer.

segments.src: For now, the ruling stands as a reminder that even the president's own residence comes with limits — a reminder rooted less in politics than in a basic legal principle: occupancy is not the same as ownership.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la décision se dresse comme un rappel que même la résidence du président lui-même a des limites — un rappel enraciné moins dans la politique que dans un principe juridique fondamental : l'occupation n'est pas la même que la propriété.

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight

segments.tr: O salão de baile em si foi apresentado pelos apoiadores como uma atualização muito esperada, dando à Casa Branca um espaço de eventos moderno e de grande capacidade para jantares de estado e funções diplomáticas em vez de confiar em tendas erguidas no Gramado Sul.

segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kasus Ini Penting Melampaui Ballroom

segments.src: Legal analysts following the case say the real stakes go well past a single construction project.
segments.tr: Para analis hukum yang mengikuti kasus ini mengatakan bahwa taruhan nyata jauh melampaui proyek konstruksi tunggal.

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?
segments.tr: Yang menjadi pertanyaan adalah: di mana kebijaksanaan presiden atas Gedung Putih berakhir, dan di mana pengawasan kongres dan publik dimulai?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: Presiden-presiden sebelumnya telah membuat perubahan pada kediaman — dari balkon yang ditambahkan ke kantor yang direnovasi — tetapi hanya sedikit, jika ada, yang mendekati skala atau harga ini, yang merupakan bagian dari alasan mengapa kasus ini telah menarik perhatian dari para sarjana konstitusi serta para advokat pelestarian bersejarah.

segments.src: A ruling that stands would reinforce the idea that the White House functions similarly to other protected federal landmarks, where alterations are subject to institutional checks regardless of who currently occupies the building.
segments.tr: Putusan yang bertahan akan memperkuat gagasan bahwa Gedung Putih berfungsi serupa dengan landmark federal yang dilindungi lainnya, di mana perubahan tunduk pada pemeriksaan institusional terlepas dari siapa yang saat ini menghuni bangunan tersebut.

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: Pembalikan, di sisi lain, akan memberi presiden masa depan kebebasan yang jauh lebih besar untuk mendanai dan melaksanakan perubahan skala besar menggunakan uang pribadi, menghindari proses anggaran kongres yang biasa.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: The administration is expected to appeal, and most observers believe the dispute is likely headed toward the Supreme Court given the constitutional questions involved about separation of powers and control over the "people's house."
segments.tr: Pemerintahan diharapkan untuk mengajukan banding, dan sebagian besar pengamat percaya bahwa perselisihan ini kemungkinan akan menuju ke Mahkamah Agung mengingat pertanyaan konstitusional yang terlibat tentang pemisahan kekuasaan dan kontrol atas "rumah rakyat."

segments.src: Construction crews have reportedly paused major work on the site while the legal process plays out, though preliminary planning and design work may continue.
segments.tr: Kru konstruksi dilaporkan telah menghentikan pekerjaan besar di situs tersebut sementara proses hukum berlangsung, meskipun pekerjaan perencanaan dan desain awal dapat dilanjutkan.

segments.src: For now, the ruling stands as a reminder that even the president's own residence comes with limits — a reminder rooted less in politics than in a basic legal principle: occupancy is not the same as ownership.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, putusan berdiri sebagai pengingat bahwa bahkan kediaman presiden sendiri memiliki batasan — pengingat yang berakar pada prinsip hukum dasar daripada politik: menghuni tidak sama dengan memiliki.

ja.title: 所有者ではなく、単なる占有者：連邦裁判所がトランプの4億ドルのホワイトハウス・バルルーム計画を停止

segments.src: A federal appeals court has thrown a major legal obstacle in front of one of the Trump administration's most talked-about construction projects: a sprawling, privately funded ballroom addition to the White House estimated at roughly $400 million.
segments.tr: 連邦控訴裁判所は、トランプ政権で最も注目を集めている建設プロジェクトの1つに対して、大きな法的障害を投じた。それはホワイトハウスへの広大な民間資金による客間の増築であり、およそ4億ドルと見積もられている。

segments.src: In a split 2-1 decision, the panel ordered a halt to further construction until Congress signs off on the plan, setting up what could become a landmark Supreme Court showdown over how much authority a sitting president actually has to remake a building that belongs, in the judges' words, to the nation rather than to any one occupant.
segments.tr: 2対1の判決で、パネルは議会がこの計画に同意するまで建設の中止を命じた。これは判事たちの言葉を借りると国家に属する建物を再造成する権限を、現職大統領が実際にどの程度持つかについての歴史的な最高裁判所の対決となる可能性がある。

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## 裁判所の決定

segments.src: The majority opinion centered on a deceptively simple idea: the president lives in the White House, but does not own it.
segments.tr: 多数派意見は一見シンプルな考えを中心としていた。大統領はホワイトハウスに住んでいるが、所有していない。

segments.src: The building is federal property held in trust for the public, and major structural changes historically have required some form of congressional review or funding approval.
segments.tr: 建物は公共のために信託された連邦財産であり、大規模な構造的変更は歴史的に何らかの議会審査または資金承認が必要だった。

segments.src: The panel found that the ballroom project — one of the largest physical alterations to the executive mansion in decades — crossed a threshold that could not be authorized by executive discretion or private donations alone.
segments.tr: パネルは、客間プロジェクト（数十年で大統領邸宅への最大の物理的改変の1つ）が、大統領の裁量または民間寄付だけでは承認できない閾値を超えたと判断した。

segments.src: The dissenting judge argued the opposite, warning that the ruling could open the door to years of litigation any time a future president wants to renovate, redecorate, or expand facilities at the White House, and that courts should be cautious about inserting themselves into decisions traditionally left to the executive branch.
segments.tr: 異議を唱える判事は逆を主張し、この判決が将来の大統領がホワイトハウスの施設を改築、再装飾、または拡張したい場合に何年も続く訴訟への扉を開く可能性があり、裁判所は伝統的に行政府に任せられた決定に介入することについて慎重であるべきだと警告した。

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight
segments.tr: ## 争いの中心にあるプロジェクト

segments.src: The ballroom itself has been pitched by supporters as a long-overdue upgrade, giving the White House a modern, large-capacity event space for state dinners and diplomatic functions instead of relying on tents erected on the South Lawn.
segments.tr: 客間自体は支持者によって長く待たれていたアップグレードとして宣伝されており、ホワイトハウスに南芝生に設置されたテントに頼る代わりに、国家晩餐会と外交行事のための最新の大容量イベントスペースを提供している。

segments.src: Backers point out that the project is being funded largely through private donations rather than taxpayer dollars, arguing that this should insulate it from the kind of congressional budget scrutiny that applies to publicly financed construction.
segments.tr: 支持者は、このプロジェクトが納税者資金ではなく主に民間寄付によって資金提供されていることを指摘し、公的資金による建設に適用される議会予算調査から保護されるべきだと主張している。

segments.src: Critics counter that the source of funding is beside the point.
segments.tr: 批評家は資金源は関係ないと反論する。

segments.src: Because the White House is a historic landmark and a symbol of the presidency itself, they argue any project of this scale — reshaping sightlines, altering historic structures, and potentially affecting the building's protected architectural character — needs sign-off from bodies like the National Capital Planning Commission and, ultimately, lawmakers who oversee federal property.
segments.tr: ホワイトハウスは歴史的建造物であり大統領制の象徴であるため、この規模のあらゆるプロジェクト（景観線を再形成し、歴史的構造を変更し、建物の保護された建築的特性に潜在的に影響を与える）は、国家首都計画委員会などの機関および最終的には連邦財産を監督する議員からの承認が必要だと彼らは主張している。

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Ballroom
segments.tr: ## なぜこの事件が客間を超えて重要なのか

segments.src: Legal analysts following the case say the real stakes go well past a single construction project.
segments.tr: この事件を追跡している法律専門家は、実際の利害関係は単一の建設プロジェクトをはるかに超えていると言っている。

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?
segments.tr: 問題となっているのはより広い質問だ。ホワイトハウスに対する大統領の裁量がどこで終わり、議会と公共による監視がどこで始まるのか？

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: 過去の大統領は住居に変更をもたらした（追加されたバルコニーから改築されたオフィスまで）が、この規模または価格帯に接近したものはほとんどなく、これが事件が憲法学者および歴史的保存擁護者からの注目を集めた理由の一部である。

segments.src: A ruling that stands would reinforce the idea that the White House functions similarly to other protected federal landmarks, where alterations are subject to institutional checks regardless of who currently occupies the building.
segments.tr: 当該判決は、ホワイトハウスが他の保護された連邦建造物と同様に機能するという考えを強化するだろう。ここで変更は誰が現在建物を占有しているかに関わらず機関チェックの対象となる。

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: 一方、逆転判決は将来の大統領に民間資金を使用して大規模な変更に資金提供および実行する相当な自由度を与え、通常の議会歳出プロセスを迂回するだろう。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起こるか

segments.src: The administration is expected to appeal, and most observers believe the dispute is likely headed toward the Supreme Court given the constitutional questions involved about separation of powers and control over the "people's house."
segments.tr: 政権は上訴することが予想され、ほとんどの観察者は権力の分立と「国民の家」に対する支配に関する憲法上の質問を考慮すると、紛争は最高裁判所に向かう可能性が高いと信じている。

segments.src: Construction crews have reportedly paused major work on the site while the legal process plays out, though preliminary planning and design work may continue.
segments.tr: 建設作業員は法的プロセスが進行する間、サイト上の主要な作業を中止したと報告されているが、初期計画とデザイン作業は継続する可能性がある。

segments.src: For now, the ruling stands as a reminder that even the president's own residence comes with limits — a reminder rooted less in politics than in a basic legal principle: occupancy is not the same as ownership.
segments.tr: 当面のところ、この判決は、大統領自身の住居でさえ制限が伴うということを認識させるものとして立ちはだかっている。これは政治的背景よりも基本的な法則原則に根ざした認識である。占有は所有と同じではない。

de.title: Nicht der Eigentümer, nur ein Bewohner: Gerichtsentscheidung stoppt Trumps 400-Millionen-Dollar-Plan für einen Ballsaal im Weißen Haus

segments.src: A federal appeals court has thrown a major legal obstacle in front of one of the Trump administration's most talked-about construction projects: a sprawling, privately funded ballroom addition to the White House estimated at roughly $400 million.
segments.tr: Ein Bundesberufungsgericht hat ein großes rechtliches Hindernis vor eines der umstrittensten Bauprojekte der Trump-Administration geworfen: ein ausgedehnter, privat finanzierter Ballsaal-Anbau am Weißen Haus, geschätzt auf etwa 400 Millionen Dollar.

segments.src: In a split 2-1 decision, the panel ordered a halt to further construction until Congress signs off on the plan, setting up what could become a landmark Supreme Court showdown over how much authority a sitting president actually has to remake a building that belongs, in the judges' words, to the nation rather than to any one occupant.
segments.tr: In einer geteilten 2-1-Entscheidung ordnete das Gericht einen Halt weiterer Bauarbeiten an, bis der Kongress den Plan genehmigt, was zu einem potenziellen Showdown vor dem Obersten Gerichtshof führen könnte – über die Befugnisse eines amtierenden Präsidenten, ein Gebäude umzugestalten, das, nach den Worten der Richter, der Nation gehört und nicht einem einzelnen Bewohner.

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## Was das Gericht beschloss

segments.src: The majority opinion centered on a deceptively simple idea: the president lives in the White House, but does not own it.
segments.tr: Die Mehrheitsmeinung konzentrierte sich auf eine trügerisch einfache Idee: Der Präsident lebt im Weißen Haus, besitzt es aber nicht.

segments.src: The building is federal property held in trust for the public, and major structural changes historically have required some form of congressional review or funding approval.
segments.tr: Das Gebäude ist Bundeseigentum, das treuhänderisch für die Öffentlichkeit gehalten wird, und größere Strukturveränderungen haben in der Geschichte eine Form der Überprüfung durch den Kongress oder Finanzierungsgenehmigung erfordert.

segments.src: The panel found that the ballroom project — one of the largest physical alterations to the executive mansion in decades — crossed a threshold that could not be authorized by executive discretion or private donations alone.
segments.tr: Das Gericht stellte fest, dass das Ballsaal-Projekt – eine der größten physischen Veränderungen am Präsidentenpalast in Jahrzehnten – eine Schwelle überschritten hat, die nicht allein durch die Ermessensentscheidung des Präsidenten oder private Spenden genehmigt werden konnte.

segments.src: The dissenting judge argued the opposite, warning that the ruling could open the door to years of litigation any time a future president wants to renovate, redecorate, or expand facilities at the White House, and that courts should be cautious about inserting themselves into decisions traditionally left to the executive branch.
segments.tr: Der abweichende Richter argumentierte das Gegenteil und warnte, dass die Entscheidung die Tür zu jahrelangen Rechtsstreitigkeiten öffnen könnte, wenn ein zukünftiger Präsident Einrichtungen im Weißen Haus renovieren, umdekorieren oder erweitern möchte, und dass Gerichte vorsichtig sein sollten, sich in Entscheidungen einzumischen, die traditionell dem Präsidenten vorbehalten sind.

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight
segments.tr: ## Das Projekt im Zentrum des Streits

segments.src: The ballroom itself has been pitched by supporters as a long-overdue upgrade, giving the White House a modern, large-capacity event space for state dinners and diplomatic functions instead of relying on tents erected on the South Lawn.
segments.tr: Der Ballsaal selbst wurde von Befürwortern als lange überfällige Modernisierung dargestellt und gibt dem Weißen Haus einen modernen, großen Veranstaltungsraum für Staatsdinner und diplomatische Funktionen, anstatt sich auf Zelte auf dem South Lawn zu verlassen.

segments.src: Backers point out that the project is being funded largely through private donations rather than taxpayer dollars, arguing that this should insulate it from the kind of congressional budget scrutiny that applies to publicly financed construction.
segments.tr: Befürworter weisen darauf hin, dass das Projekt in erster Linie durch private Spenden statt Steuermittel finanziert wird, und argumentieren, dass dies vor der Art der Haushaltsprüfung durch den Kongress schützen sollte, die für öffentlich finanzierte Bauarbeiten gilt.

segments.src: Critics counter that the source of funding is beside the point.
segments.tr: Kritiker argumentieren dagegen, dass die Finanzierungsquelle irrelevant ist.

segments.src: Because the White House is a historic landmark and a symbol of the presidency itself, they argue any project of this scale — reshaping sightlines, altering historic structures, and potentially affecting the building's protected architectural character — needs sign-off from bodies like the National Capital Planning Commission and, ultimately, lawmakers who oversee federal property.
segments.tr: Da das Weiße Haus ein historisches Wahrzeichen und ein Symbol der Präsidentschaft selbst ist, argumentieren sie, dass jedes Projekt diesen Ausmaßes – Umgestaltung von Sichtlinien, Veränderung historischer Strukturen und möglicherweise Beeinträchtigung des geschützten architektonischen Charakters des Gebäudes – Zustimmung von Gremien wie der National Capital Planning Commission und letztendlich von Gesetzgebern, die Bundeseigentum beaufsichtigen, benötigt.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Ballroom
segments.tr: ## Warum dieser Fall über den Ballsaal hinausgeht

segments.src: Legal analysts following the case say the real stakes go well past a single construction project.
segments.tr: Juristische Analysten, die den Fall verfolgen, sagen, dass der wirkliche Einsatz weit über ein einzelnes Bauprojekt hinausgeht.

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?
segments.tr: Es geht um eine breitere Frage: Wo endet die Ermessensentscheidung des Präsidenten über das Weiße Haus, und wo beginnt die Überwachung durch den Kongress und die Öffentlichkeit?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: Frühere Präsidenten haben Änderungen an der Residenz vorgenommen – von hinzugefügten Balkonen bis zu renovierten Büros – aber nur wenige, wenn überhaupt, haben sich diesem Umfang oder dieser Preisklasse genähert, was teilweise erklärt, warum der Fall Aufmerksamkeit von Verfassungsrechtlern sowie Befürwortern des historischen Denkmalschutzes auf sich gezogen hat.

segments.src: A ruling that stands would reinforce the idea that the White House functions similarly to other protected federal landmarks, where alterations are subject to institutional checks regardless of who currently occupies the building.
segments.tr: Ein bestätigendes Urteil würde die Idee verstärken, dass das Weiße Haus ähnlich wie andere geschützte Bundesdenkmäler funktioniert, wo Veränderungen unabhängig davon, wer das Gebäude aktuell bewohnt, institutionellen Kontrollen unterliegen.

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: Eine Umkehrung würde zukünftigen Präsidenten andererseits erheblich mehr Spielraum geben, großangelegte Veränderungen mit privaten Mitteln zu finanzieren und durchzuführen, wodurch der üblichen Mittelzuweisungsprozess des Kongresses umgangen würde.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Was kommt als Nächstes

segments.src: The administration is expected to appeal, and most observers believe the dispute is likely headed toward the Supreme Court given the constitutional questions involved about separation of powers and control over the "people's house."
segments.tr: Die Administration wird voraussichtlich Berufung einlegen, und die meisten Beobachter glauben, dass der Streit angesichts der beteiligten Verfassungsfragen zur Gewaltenteilung und Kontrolle über das "Haus des Volkes" wahrscheinlich vor dem Obersten Gerichtshof landen wird.

segments.src: Construction crews have reportedly paused major work on the site while the legal process plays out, though preliminary planning and design work may continue.
segments.tr: Bautrupps haben Berichten zufolge die Hauptarbeiten auf der Baustelle unterbrochen, während der Rechtsstreit andauert, obwohl vorläufige Planungs- und Designarbeiten fortgesetzt werden können.

segments.src: For now, the ruling stands as a reminder that even the president's own residence comes with limits — a reminder rooted less in politics than in a basic legal principle: occupancy is not the same as ownership.
segments.tr: Derzeit steht die Entscheidung als Erinnerung daran, dass sogar die eigene Residenz des Präsidenten Grenzen hat – eine Erinnerung, die weniger in der Politik als in einem grundlegenden Rechtsprinzip verwurzelt ist: Bewohnung ist nicht dasselbe wie Eigentum.

segments.tr: Một tòa án kháng cáo liên bang đã đưa ra một trở ngại pháp lý lớn phía trước một trong những dự án xây dựng được nói đến nhiều nhất của chính quyền Trump: một phần mở rộng phòng khiêu vũ được tài trợ riêng ở Nhà Trắng ước tính khoảng $400 triệu.

segments.src: ## The Project at the Center of the Fight
segments.tr: ## Dự Án Ở Trung Tâm Của Cuộc Tranh Chấp

segments.src: The ballroom itself has been pitched by supporters as a long-overdue upgrade, giving the White House a modern, large-capacity event space for state dinners and diplomatic functions instead of relying on tents erected on the South Lawn.
segments.tr: Phòng khiêu vũ chính nó đã được các nhà ủng hộ đề cập như một nâng cấp đã quá hạn, cung cấp cho Nhà Trắng một không gian sự kiện hiện đại, công suất lớn cho các bữa tối nhà nước và các chức năng ngoại giao thay vì dựa vào các lều được dựng lên trên South Lawn.

segments.src: Backers point out that the project is being funded largely through private donations rather than taxpayer dollars, arguing that this should insulate it from the kind of congressional budget scrutiny that applies to publicly financed construction.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ chỉ ra rằng dự án được tài trợ chủ yếu thông qua các đóng góp riêng tư thay vì tiền của người nộp thuế, lập luận rằng điều này sẽ bảo vệ nó khỏi loại kiểm tra ngân sách của Quốc hội áp dụng cho xây dựng được tài trợ công cộng.

segments.src: Critics counter that the source of funding is beside the point.
segments.tr: Những người chỉ trích phản đối rằng nguồn tài chính là ngoài vấn đề.

segments.src: Because the White House is a historic landmark and a symbol of the presidency itself, they argue any project of this scale — reshaping sightlines, altering historic structures, and potentially affecting the building's protected architectural character — needs sign-off from bodies like the National Capital Planning Commission and, ultimately, lawmakers who oversee federal property.
segments.tr: Bởi vì Nhà Trắng là một địa danh lịch sử và một biểu tượng của chính quyền tổng thống, họ lập luận bất kỳ dự án nào ở quy mô này — định hình lại tầm nhìn, thay đổi các cấu trúc lịch sử, và có khả năng ảnh hưởng đến tính chất kiến trúc được bảo vệ của tòa nhà — cần phê duyệt từ các cơ quan như Ủy ban Lập kế hoạch Thủ đô Quốc gia và, cuối cùng, những nhà lập pháp giám sát tài sản liên bang.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Ballroom
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Vụ Việc Này Quan Trọng Vượt Ra Ngoài Phòng Khiêu Vũ

segments.src: Legal analysts following the case say the real stakes go well past a single construction project.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích pháp lý theo dõi vụ việc nói rằng những cược thực sự vượt xa một dự án xây dựng duy nhất.

segments.src: At issue is a broader question: where does presidential discretion over the White House end, and where does congressional and public oversight begin?
segments.tr: Vấn đề được đặt ra là một câu hỏi rộng hơn: quyền tự do quyết định của tổng thống đối với Nhà Trắng kết thúc ở đâu, và giám sát của Quốc hội và công chúng bắt đầu ở đâu?

segments.src: Past presidents have made changes to the residence — from added balconies to renovated offices — but few, if any, have approached this scale or price tag, which is part of why the case has drawn attention from constitutional scholars as well as historic preservation advocates.
segments.tr: Các tổng thống trong quá khứ đã thực hiện các thay đổi đối với cư trú — từ những ban công được thêm vào cho đến các văn phòng được sửa chữa — nhưng rất ít, nếu có, đã tiếp cận quy mô hoặc giá cả này, đây là một phần lý do tại sao vụ việc đã thu hút sự chú ý từ các học giả hiến pháp cũng như những người ủng hộ bảo tồn lịch sử.

segments.src: A ruling that stands would reinforce the idea that the White House functions similarly to other protected federal landmarks, where alterations are subject to institutional checks regardless of who currently occupies the building.
segments.tr: Một phán quyết đứng vững sẽ củng cố ý tưởng rằng Nhà Trắng hoạt động tương tự như các địa danh liên bang được bảo vệ khác, nơi các thay đổi tuân theo các kiểm tra thể chế bất kể ai hiện đang chiếm đóng tòa nhà.

segments.src: A reversal, on the other hand, would give future presidents considerably more latitude to fund and execute large-scale changes using private money, sidestepping the usual congressional appropriations process.
segments.tr: Một đảo ngược, mặt khác, sẽ cung cấp cho những tổng thống trong tương lai nhiều hành động hơn để tài trợ và thực hiện những thay đổi quy mô lớn bằng cách sử dụng tiền riêng tư, vượt qua quá trình cấp quỹ thông thường của Quốc hội.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều Gì Sẽ Xảy Ra Tiếp Theo

segments.src: The administration is expected to appeal, and most observers believe the dispute is likely headed toward the Supreme Court given the constitutional questions involved about separation of powers and control over the "people's house."
segments.tr: Chính quyền được dự kiến sẽ kháng cáo, và hầu hết những người quan sát tin rằng tranh chấp có khả năng đi đến Tòa án Tối cao được đưa ra những câu hỏi hiến pháp liên quan đến sự tách biệt quyền lực và kiểm soát "nhà của nhân dân."

segments.src: Construction crews have reportedly paused major work on the site while the legal process plays out, though preliminary planning and design work may continue.
segments.tr: Những đội xây dựng được cho là đã dừng công việc chính trên địa bàn trong khi quá trình pháp lý diễn ra, mặc dù công việc lập kế hoạch và thiết kế sơ bộ có thể tiếp tục.

segments.src: For now, the ruling stands as a reminder that even the president's own residence comes with limits — a reminder rooted less in politics than in a basic legal principle: occupancy is not the same as ownership.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, phán quyết đứng vững như một lời nhắc nhở rằng ngay cả cư trú riêng của tổng thống cũng đi kèm với những giới hạn — một lời nhắc nhở ít bắt nguồn từ chính trị hơn là từ một nguyên tắc pháp lý cơ bản: chiếm hữu không giống như sở hữu.
